profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group is a public company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with the ticker SFTBF. According to its website, SoftBank Group Corp. is led by Masayoshi Son as Representative Director, Chairman and President Executive Officer. The site presents the group's philosophy, vision, strategy, corporate information, shareholder and investor relations information, business segments and group companies, and sustainability and ESG information.

The website also introduces the group's thinking in what it calls the era of the AI revolution, along with initiatives of group companies and the possibilities AI brings. No specific AI products are named in the available material.
